verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents its own unattended-run capabilities: a headless server-only mode (-s), a lightweight server package aimed at headless and CI environments, and a launch configuration script that specifies which programs and plugins to run. Together these let simulations run in the background without a GUI. However, none of this amounts to user-configurable autonomous automations such as scheduled, triggered or agent-driven background tasks. Custom plugins are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: scheduling or trigger mechanisms, background job/automation management, AI-agent-driven autonomous workflows, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
